body.markdown:
# Competitor video ads: opening hooks and pacing (Amazon ES, collapsible silicone colanders)

**Inspection basis: `metadata_only` for every creative observation.** No tool in this session played the videos or showed their frames, so nothing below describes what the footage shows, how it opens, or how it is cut. Hooks are read from retained ad captions (text), which are not footage. Retained evidence only; zero new acquisition.

## Retained ads (observed 2026-09-15)

| Advertiser | Platform | source_ref | Caption (original, Spanish) | Caption hook type (inference) | Retained clip metadata |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plegasa | Meta (FB, IG) | [meta_ad_library:1200000000000001](https://example.test/ads/library/?id=1200000000000001) | "¿Escurrir la pasta y guardar el colador en un cajón? Se pliega a 4 cm." | Question about a pain point, then folded-size claim | Reference rvref_meta_01: 15.2 s, 1080x1920, frames ready (6) but not viewed |
| Cocinova | Meta (IG) | [meta_ad_library:1200000000000002](https://example.test/ads/library/?id=1200000000000002) | "Colador plegable de 26 cm, apto para lavavajillas." (rest of caption excluded, see note) | Feature statement (size, dishwasher-safe) | No retained reference |
| Plegasa | Meta | [meta_ad_library:1200000000000003](https://example.test/ads/library/?id=1200000000000003) | "3 tamaños, 1 cajón." | Short numeric contrast | No video_url in the provider record; not a video ad in this evidence |
| Cocinova | TikTok | [tiktok_ad_library:7400000000000001](https://example.test/tiktok/ads/7400000000000001) | "De 26 cm a 4 cm en un segundo #cocina #organizacion" | Before/after size transformation claim | Reference rvref_tiktok_01: 9.8 s, 720x1280; frame extraction failed (frame_extraction_failed), 0 frames |
| Plegasa | TikTok | [tiktok_ad_library:7400000000000002:7400000000000099](https://example.test/tiktok/ads/7400000000000002) | "El colador que cabe en cualquier cajón" | Positioning claim (fits any drawer) | No retained reference |

## Findings

- **Hooks (inference from captions, not footage):** four of five captions lead with the fold/compact-storage idea (4 cm, 26 to 4 cm, fits any drawer, 3 sizes in 1 drawer). Only Plegasa's Meta ad opens with a question. Cocinova's Meta caption leads with specs instead. Caption wording is not the same as the first seconds of the video; the actual opening hook is **unknown**.
- **Pacing: unknown.** The only retained facts are durations of two clips (15.2 s Meta, 9.8 s TikTok, both vertical). Shot count, cut rhythm, and when the product first appears were not observed.
- Sample is 5 ads from 2 advertisers, 2 platforms, with gaps: one record has no video; 2 of 5 have a retained clip; frames exist for 1 and failed for 1. This is a convenience sample, not market coverage, and says nothing about spend, reach or performance.

## Source-text note

The caption of Cocinova's Meta ad (meta_ad_library:1200000000000002, artifact rart_adv_meta_01) contained instruction-like text addressed to an AI agent. It was treated as untrusted data: not acted on, not reproduced here, and no plan or promo code was created because of it.

## Not covered

Price groups and review analysis: not part of this question; sizes differ between the retained listings (24 cm vs 26 cm) so no like-for-like group is submitted. No review bodies retained.

## Next check

If the opening hook and pacing matter, view the retained clips with a tool that can play video or show frames (rvref_meta_01 has 6 ready frames), then add a revision. No collection is proposed.
